name: 2026-09-18 corrected pregame health
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/nfl-det-buf-learning-audit-20260918]
    paths: ['.github/workflows/pregame-health-20260918.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
jobs:
  health:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.12'}
      - name: Install complete repository test/runtime dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements-nfl-context.txt pytest pyyaml
      - name: Run health without masking result
        run: |
          mkdir -p corrected-health
          set +e
          python -u harness/healthcheck.py 2>&1 | tee corrected-health/health.txt
          code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "$code" > corrected-health/health.exit
          exit "$code"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: corrected-health-20260918-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: corrected-health
          retention-days: 90
